# Asterisk

> Asterisk is an independent magazine exploring the intersection of science, technology, economics, and policy through long-form journalism and critical analysis.

Asterisk publishes in-depth articles on research funding, industrial policy, AI applications, and institutional analysis. The magazine is edited by Clara Collier, Angela Chen, and Peter Kranitz, with contributions from writers including Abhishaike Mahajan, Jolie Gan, Adam Marblestone, and Leah Libresco Sargeant.

## Key Topics

- science policy
- research funding
- semiconductors
- artificial intelligence
- autonomous vehicles
- drug development
- industrial policy
- history of science
- education reform
- technology industry
- Taiwan
- China
- neuroscience
- language evolution
- institutional analysis

## Science & Research Policy

- [The Fight For Slow And Boring Research](https://asteriskmag.com/issues/13/the-fight-for-slow-and-boring-research): Jolie Gan examines federal research funding challenges at NIH and NSF
- [Justified True Belief](https://asteriskmag.com/issues/13/justified-true-belief): Clara Collier editorial on science communication and epistemic hygiene
- [A Brief History of the History of Science](https://asteriskmag.com/issues/13/a-brief-history-of-the-history-of-science): History of science field traced from James Bryant Conant and Manhattan Project
- [Rethinking High-School Science Fairs](https://asteriskmag.com/issues/13/rethinking-high-school-science-fairs): Leah Libresco Sargeant proposes reforms to competitive high school science fairs

## Technology & Industrial Policy

- [The Institute Behind Taiwan's Chip Dominance](https://asteriskmag.com/issues/13/the-institute-behind-taiwan-s-chip-dominance): How ITRI and TSMC implemented Taiwan's successful semiconductor industrial policy
- [Factory Logic](https://asteriskmag.com/issues/13/factory-logic): Analysis of 'Made in Ethiopia' documentary on Chinese manufacturing industrialization
- [Seeing Like a Sedan](https://asteriskmag.com/issues/13/seeing-like-a-sedan): Comparison of Waymo lidar vs Tesla vision approaches to autonomous vehicles

## AI & Life Sciences

- [AI After Drug Development](https://asteriskmag.com/issues/13/ai-after-drug-development): Abhishaike Mahajan on AI applications beyond drug candidate discovery
- [The Sweet Lesson of Neuroscience](https://asteriskmag.com/issues/13/the-sweet-lesson-of-neuroscience): Adam Marblestone on AI insights revealing neuroscience principles about learning

## Language & Culture

- [Language Birth](https://asteriskmag.com/issues/13/language-birth): Tevfik Esençay explores language extinction and creation since 1960
- [Issue 12: Books](https://asteriskmag.com/issues/12): Issue 12 featuring book reviews, essays on culture, technology, and institutions
